findings.scales: Fine repeating scales are visibly rendered on the teal skin, oriented along the posed body. They stretch somewhat over broad torso bends and remain a regular procedural pattern, but do not break the silhouette or obscure the face at this studio framing.
findings.underside: Cream belly segmentation follows the continuous throat and torso rather than floating independently. Narrow neck rings remain orderly through raised and folded poses.
findings.wings: Subdued membrane striations add finish without replacing or overpowering the articulated fingers and scalloped outline. Opposite views retain light membrane/teal bone contrast.
findings.face: Fine swept whiskers preserve the friendly head silhouette. Tiny visible teeth do not restore the earlier exaggerated shark-mouth appearance. Attack stream obscures part of the open mouth, so occluded dental anatomy is not independently certified.
findings.macro: Clay opposites and all silhouettes show no apparent regression from approved macro-v003: continuous neck, elongated shoulder roots, swept dorsal/cheek fins and closed tail lobes remain.

limits: Posed stills show surface conformity at sampled times; they cannot certify absence of temporal texture swimming or animation pops.
